findings.claim: Observations, candidates and admitted states are unrelated types; candidates are never admitted automatically; an admitted state exists only through the gate and is immutable
An admitted synthetic state may command actuators
findings.value: not established: admission is a software gate over synthetic data; authority is decided elsewhere

hypothesis: Keeping observations, candidate states and admitted states as separate types, with a single explicit gate whose every check is load-bearing, guards against a candidate becoming state by accident, naive tampering or omission.
input_data: one synthetic camera run (seed 752026) driving a FusionSession for each scenario
14 violation scenarios covering all 13 checks, plus one valid control
mathematical_model: Admission = ordered conjunction of declared checks (declared, writable, typed, finite, covariance, integrity, provenance, frame, fresh, track, uncertainty, innovation, calibration); fresh means the most recently issued candidate at the session tick; fail closed on any exception. Mutation m_i removes check i.
numerical_result: 14/14 scenarios refused with the expected code; 14/14 mutants killed; in 12 scenarios the targeted check is the sole guard; backed up by a later check: declared, provenance (the provenance check adds a specific refusal code, but freshness already implies an issued digest).
observation_model: Typed Observation objects; candidates issued by the session and sealed by a content digest.

physical_validation_status.statement: Physical validation requires acquired hardware evidence; none was acquired for this task.

recommended_next_task: T076: confirm that the session defaults to read-only with sensor fusion and state admission not performed.
